summary: Official Bihar BhuNaksha is a verified local/state cadastral viewer lead. Its live selector path reached Saran/Sadar/Ekma and village Ekma/एकमा (163), but the bounded public extent request returned empty and no safe native parcel ID plus polygon was verified. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Hindi discovery queries, exact text, outcomes, and actual first-party URLs are recorded in city-10857-ekma.json.
requestOutcomes: The official viewer HTML, configuration, current JavaScript, location selectors, and REST route names were inspected. Selector POSTs returned Bihar/Saran/Sadar/Ekma and the Ekma village entry. The confirmed-location getVVVVExtentGeoref POST returned an empty body, so no parcel payload was retained.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [25.9306107654707, 84.5626213627248] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift or exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
Local/state cadastral custody is evidenced by the official Bihar viewer and its Ekma location hierarchy, but citywide open parcel coverage was not verified.
No parcel geometry, stable native parcel identity, usable CRS, or native field schema was retrieved or retained.
A zero exact-point hit, empty extent response, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
Only safe public map metadata and location selectors were requested; no owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal, or unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research bookkeeping only and does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial review remains required.
